Submit one initial order for each examination; capture actual command IDs and pending states
Pause before 30 simulation seconds; verify no result or wall-clock catch-up after restart
Resume to due time and verify exactly one RESULTED event/result per command in both CM and EXCON
Open both local images; verify generated-image label, chest attribution, synthetic reports and no false hemothorax confirmation
Verify repeat controls unavailable; mode switching/restart does not add commands or results
Reset with pending and resulted state; verify generation change, empty labs/imaging and T+0 after restart
Restore original network settings and verify canonical application coexistence without production mutations
